summary: Frontend-only testing of Sprint 1 Outbound Module UI. All 5 sub-modules (Transfers, RTV, Adjustments, Write-offs, V-Flip) tested successfully. Navigation, List views, Create forms, Detail views, and special features (cross-state e-way bill, V-flip confirm modal) all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Form validation working correctly (e.g., e-way bill required for cross-state)
Tab toggles working for Transfers (inter-store/store-split) and RTV (defective/seasonal)
Adjustment lines auto-calculate adj_qty from book_qty and counted_qty
V-flip confirm modal shows proper warning about irreversible action
seed_data_creation: Created test records: 1 transfer (DEO→BKR), 1 cross-state transfer (BANKA→BKR with e-way bill), 1 RTV, 1 adjustment, 1 write-off, 1 V-flip
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Outbound module fully tested. All 5 sub-flows working: Transfers (with cross-state e-way bill validation), RTV (defective/seasonal tabs), Adjustments (auto-calc adj), Write-offs, V-Flip (with confirm modal). Backend APIs return expected responses. Test data created with TEST- prefix SKUs.

navigation.details: OUTBOUND nav group visible with 5 items: Transfers, Return to Vendor, Adjustments, Write-offs, V-Flip

transfer_create.details: 3-step form (Locations, Transport, Lines) works. Source/dest store dropdowns, type, reason, transport mode/ref/dispatcher/arrival fields all functional.

transfer_detail.details: Shows header, stats cards (Transport, Dispatcher, Dispatched/Received, Date), lines table. Dispatch button visible on draft.

cross_state_transfer.details: Cross-state warning appears when source/dest in different states. E-way bill field becomes visible and required. Validation error shown when missing.

rtv_list.details: Table shows columns: Doc#, Store, Type, Logistics, Lines, Credit note, Status, Date. Tab toggle between Defective/Season-end works.

rtv_create.details: Form with store, vendor, brand, type, logistics, season, lines works. Submit RTV button on detail page.

adjustments_list.details: Table shows columns: Doc#, Store, Reason, Lines, Net variance, Status, Date. Net variance shows +/- with color coding.

adjustment_create.details: Form with store, reason, notes, lines (book_qty, counted_qty). Adj column auto-calculates (counted - book).

writeoffs_list.details: Table shows columns: Doc#, Store, Reason, Lines, Total qty, Status, Date.

writeoff_create.details: Form with store, reason, lines works. Submit write-off button on detail page.

vflips_list.details: Info banner about V-flip purpose visible. Table shows columns: Doc#, Store, Original brand, Season, Lines, Total qty, Status, Date.

vflip_create.details: Form with store, brand, season, lines works.

vflip_confirm_modal.details: Flip ownership button opens confirm modal with warning text about irreversible action. Confirm flip button present.
